art_direction.visual_motif: Earthy, Ascetic, Pragmatic. They spent 13 years in exile; their garments should reflect faded royalty mixed with forest pragmatism.
art_direction.armor_reference_era: Historical Kushan / Early Gupta era (leather lamellar, simple bronze breastplates, NOT shining full-plate medieval armor).
do_not_use_tropes: No over-the-top glowing golden aura unless a divine weapon (Astra) is actively drawn.
No clean, perfectly pressed silk during the war Parvas.

art_direction.visual_motif: Opulent, Rigid, Imperial. They hold the wealth of Hastinapura. Regimental and imposing.
art_direction.armor_reference_era: Late Mauryan / Heavy infantry scale mail. Chariots heavily gilded.
do_not_use_tropes: Do not make them look like generic 'evil demons'. They are noble Kshatriyas pursuing a flawed Dharma.
Avoid pure black/red 'villain' coding. Use rich purples and golds to signify entrenched wealth.

art_direction.visual_motif: Ethereal, detached. Vyasa, Sanjaya, Bhishma (when teaching in Shanti Parva).
do_not_use_tropes: No floating lotus physical pedestals. Ground them in the dirt.

audio_shlokas.instrumentation: Solo Rudra Veena, no percussion, sparse.
audio_shlokas.sanskrit_lyrics: kṛpayā parayāviṣṭo viṣīdann idam abravīt... sīdanti mama gātrāṇi mukhaṃ ca pariśuṣyati (Overwhelmed by deep pity, in sorrow he spoke: My limbs fail and my mouth is parched.)

audio_shlokas.instrumentation: Heavy Pakhawaj drumming building to a crescendo with a male choir.
audio_shlokas.sanskrit_lyrics: karmaṇy-evādhikāras te mā phaleṣhu kadāchana (You have a right to perform your prescribed duty, but you are not entitled to the fruits of action.)

audio_shlokas.instrumentation: Melancholy Bansuri (Bamboo Flute) fading into silence.
audio_shlokas.sanskrit_lyrics: Instrumental only, symbolizing the sun setting on the greatest tragic hero.
hiraṇmayena pātreṇa satyasyāpihitaṃ mukham (The face of Truth is hidden by a golden disk...)

audio_shlokas.instrumentation: Low, dissonant strings playing at a slow tempo.
audio_shlokas.sanskrit_lyrics: yatra dharmo hy adharmeṇa satyaṃ yatrānṛtena ca (Where Dharma is slain by Adharma, and Truth by Falsehood...)
